title: DJ Khaled Drops God Did Track & Says GOD Wanted Him To Buy $3 Million Watch [Video]
htmlContent:
DJ Khaled shared the God Did tracklist, his thirteenth studio album that will be coming out on Friday.

The 18-track project will include performances by Jay-Z, Kanye West, Eminem, SZA, Rick Ross, Roddy Ricch, Quavo, Takeoff, Lil Wayne, 21 Savage, Drake, and much more. “This is a gift to the world,” Khaled wrote when sharing the tracklist with fans.

On Thursday, Future posted a video on his Instagram story asking Khaled Did GOD tell you to buy this $ 3 million watch? Who told you to buy it, said Future?

GOD Did!

The DJ also recently revealed in interview with Billboard According to Khaled, he maintained the same formula by asking Hov to choose one cover among two options while revealing the legendary rap of Brooklyn thinks that God Did is his best album.

“I am the biggest JAY-Z fan, and I actually let him pick my album cover. I always give him like two cover options and see which one he would pick, and I did it again on this album,” Khaled said. “After I got done playing it, he pulled me aside and said, ‘Yo, this is your best album.’ JAY-Z, I love you, and you know that.”

“VGOD DID OFFICIAL ALBUM COVER,” he wrote. “The tear represents tears of joy from God’s blessings GOD, I LOVE U SO MUCH! ???? ?????? ?? ?? ???????? ?? ???? ???, ?? ???? ? ????? ??? ??? ??? ?????? ?? Thank you god for blessing my family, my friends and my fans. When nobody believed, YOU DID! I praise you daily. We’re here to do GODS WORK!!”
